verdict.rationale: Devin's own docs state it supports AGENTS.md, an open-standard project file for giving instructions and context to the agent. That directly covers adding a project instructions file. The Knowledge feature is a related, non-file mechanism for persistent instructions across sessions. missing for 10: detail on how AGENTS.md is loaded, scoped, or prioritized; explicit examples of coding standards and conventions being enforced; independent hands-on confirmation that Devin follows the file.

support.subject: As a developer, I can add a project instructions file to set coding standards and conventions the agent follows

citations.quote: Devin supports AGENTS.md - a simple, open standard for providing context and instructions to AI agents.
Knowledge is a collection of instructions and advice that Devin can reference in all sessions.
